name: 11105 · Astoria, NY
findings: ZIP 11105 (Astoria) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11105 (Astoria) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
91% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11105 (Astoria) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
